stances.quote: I will do my best to ensure our military has what they need to keep us safe and protect our way of life, as well as thoroughly examine all legislation to ensure our national defense community is able to build upon its proud history.
stances.reasoning: Text repeatedly emphasizes supporting and equipping the military with necessary resources and funding.

stances.quote: The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act allows hardworking Americans keep more of their paycheck, creates jobs and increases wages by making American businesses competitive again, and simplifies a code that has become riddled with loopholes.
stances.reasoning: Explicit endorsement of tax cuts that reduce burdens on individuals and businesses.

stances.quote: I made a commitment to the people of the Third District of Arkansas to cut spending and to make the necessary reforms to put our budget on a sustainable path... I have voted for a balanced budget amendment to the Constitution. I have voted for budgets that actually balance... reduce – discretionary spending... fight for fiscal sanity.
stances.reasoning: Strong, repeated commitment to cutting spending, balancing budgets, and reducing the deficit.
No statements on tariffs, protectionism, or free trade appear in the text.

stances.quote: Although some argue against the merits of foreign aid, it is important to note that it accounts for less than one percent of the federal budget... I will continue to support our interests abroad, while ensuring that tax payer dollars are used to increase security and expand economic growth.
stances.reasoning: Defends foreign aid spending as a small but valuable portion of the budget and commits to continuing support.

stances.quote: The passage of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (PPACA) was an unprecedented expansion of government... Congress must continue to focus on repealing and amending the most troublesome aspects of the law and pass real reforms – such as tort reforms and health insurance portability – that will bend health care’s exploding cost curve.
stances.reasoning: Opposes government expansion in healthcare and advocates market-oriented reforms like tort reform and portability.
No statements on campaign finance, limits, or disclosure requirements appear in the text.
